resources.string: ROOT MASTER inspects your device, tells you whether it can be rooted with an official method, guides you through it, and manages root only when it has really been verified.
A normal app cannot give itself root. Nothing here is simulated: every status shown comes from a real check, and anything that cannot be checked is shown as unavailable.
Each permission is explained and needs your separate decision. Status is read from the system, not assumed.
Download the official Magisk release information and APK from GitHub.
Know whether a connection exists before a download.
Detect root manager apps and show app names in the root request list.
Hand the verified Magisk APK to the system installer. You enable it in Settings.
Signature-level system permission. A normal app cannot receive it; reboot is possible only through root, with your confirmation.
System permission. Not obtainable by a normal app and not needed by this app.
Cannot be granted by this app. It exists only after a successful rooting process and is then approved in the root manager.
Confirming only records your decisions. It does not mean the app has root.
Root is reported only if the command su really returned uid 0.
Values the system does not expose to apps are shown as unavailable, not guessed.
The device restarted. Result of re-verification:
Possible, but the bootloader must be unlocked first
Not supported by an official method
boot.img or init_boot.img (use the one present in your firmware)
Unknown means the system did not let the app read it; it is never counted as a pass.
The process is stopped for this device.
CPU architecture not supported by Magisk.
Android version is older than Magisk supports.
The bootloader is locked and the device reports no OEM unlock support.
The manufacturer no longer provides official bootloader unlocking.
A computer with ADB and fastboot (platform-tools).
The stock boot image (or init_boot) from the exact firmware build installed now.
A full backup of your data.
Unlock the bootloader with the manufacturer\'s official method.
A Mi account approved in the official Mi Unlock tool (waiting period applies).
Samsung flow: patch the AP file and flash it with Odin after unlocking via the OEM unlock toggle.
The official Magisk app, nothing else.
Unlocking the bootloader erases all data on the device.
A wrong or mismatched image can cause a boot loop or a bricked device.
Banking, payment and some games may refuse to run (Play Integrity).
System updates can remove root and may fail to install.
A boot warning screen about the unlocked state is shown at every start.
Battery is below 50%; an interrupted flash can brick the device.
Only the official Magisk release from GitHub is used. Its file is installed only if its SHA-256 matches the digest GitHub publishes for it.
Installation is disabled for this device (see Compat).
Internet permission was not allowed in the permissions step; lookups and downloads will not run.

The file below will be downloaded and installed only if its SHA-256 matches. Rooting itself is done afterwards with the Magisk app and fastboot; this app cannot flash partitions. Read the risks first:
Steps marked Manual happen outside this app. The app cannot do them and does not pretend to.
Patch the stock image in the Magisk app
Flash the patched image from a computer
Only flash an image made from your exact firmware. Follow the official Magisk installation guide for your device.
After flashing, restart the device. When you open the app again it re-checks root automatically and shows the real result.

The device will restart. Unsaved work is lost, and a bad image can cause a boot loop. The app never restarts the device without this confirmation. Without root the app cannot restart it for you: restart it yourself.
Available only after root is verified for real. Current state is on the Device tab.
Management here works through the Magisk command-line interface only. Manage this root in its own app.
Every action runs through su, so your root manager still decides whether this app is allowed. No app is approved automatically.
